title: Service Test 45: Ice maker water fill

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)
source.oemTestTitle: Ref. Compartment Ice Maker Water Fill Test

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Harvest ice before fill test
steps.body: Before test 45, run Service Test 57 and initiate harvest so mold is empty (per manual NOTE).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Before test 45, run Service Test 57 and initiate harvest so mold is empty (per manual NOTE).

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 45
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 45. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 45 — Ice maker water fill

steps.title: Observe fill state
steps.body: After 3-second delay, display shows ice maker water fill state. Press SW3 to start fill; toggles 02=off, 03=on, 04=paused.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After 3-second delay, display shows ice maker water fill state. Press SW3 to start fill; toggles 02=off, 03=on, 04=paused.

steps.title: Water enters mold
steps.body: With fill on (03), does water enter the ice maker mold? P3-3 ice maker valve should energize.
steps.sourceExcerpt: With fill on (03), does water enter the ice maker mold? P3-3 ice maker valve should energize.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: No water at mold — valve, supply, or frozen fill tube (see test 19).

steps.title: Check valve and fill tube
steps.oemOutcome: Verify household supply, dual water valve (green 20 W / red 35 W), and fill tube heater path.

steps.title: Ice maker fill verified
steps.oemOutcome: Water fill operates correctly in service test 45.
